evals.prompt: Create a new documentation architecture diagram showing how Agentweaver turns a confirmed OutcomeSpec into parallel child runs and one reviewed result. Use the repository implementation as ground truth.
evals.expected_output: A one-page A5, uncompressed, editable draw.io pitch plus an inspected PNG and research/change record, followed by an explicit handoff to docs-diagram-iterate.
expectations: The workflow runs two or three independent subject-research threads and records evidence.
Visual references, official logos or native symbols, and asset rights are researched.
The source is uncompressed editable draw.io XML on one A5 page.
The output distinguishes native draw.io symbols from Agentweaver-specific custom components.
The actual exported pitch PNG is inspected at print size and enlarged detail.
The pitch is not represented as publication-ready and is handed to docs-diagram-iterate.

evals.prompt: Our AKS deployment guide needs a completely redesigned architecture picture separating ingress, services, workloads, and durable state. Make it editable and preserve the Agentweaver look.
evals.expected_output: A grounded A5 draw.io pitch using native Azure, Kubernetes, networking, database, and cloud symbols where semantically correct, with Agentweaver styling and credits.
expectations: Native Azure and Kubernetes symbols are preferred over custom approximations.
Agentweaver card hierarchy, palette, group surfaces, and connector conventions remain intact.
Every component and connector is backed by repository evidence.
The editable source, PNG, and pitch record are separate artifacts.

evals.prompt: Turn this service inventory into a generic Mermaid flowchart for a scratchpad. It is not for Agentweaver documentation.
evals.expected_output: The docs-diagram-pitch skill should not trigger because the request is neither Agentweaver documentation nor draw.io authoring.
expectations: The skill description excludes generic Mermaid scratchpad work.

evals.prompt: Fix the typo and one reversed arrow in the existing docs/diagrams/src/control-plane.drawio.
evals.expected_output: The pitch skill should defer to docs-diagram-iterate because this is a correction to an existing draw.io diagram.
expectations: The skill description differentiates new/redesigned diagrams from existing-diagram corrections.

evals.prompt: Inventory all documentation diagrams, classify each as retain, reuse, merge, remove, or redesign, then prepare independent batches for guide and deep-dive agents without migrating anything yet.
evals.expected_output: A validated inventory with stable names/output paths, explicit dispositions and targets, and non-overlapping owner-area selections.
expectations: The workflow discovers diagrams and documentation references without changing them.
Every diagram has one disposition and one owner area.
Reuse and merge decisions identify a target diagram.
Selections can be filtered by exact name and owner area.
Parallel batches cannot assign the same diagram to multiple writers.
